How to play
Two-player community-card poker with explicit simplified fixed-limit betting. Each starts40 chips, blinds1/2 alternate. Two private cards each; shared flop3, turn1, river1. Betting before flop/after each reveal, up to three raises per street, raise size2 preflop/flop and4 turn/river. Check if no owed bet, call matching owed, fold surrender pot, raise if affordable. Equal stacks; all-in caps contest to matched contribution, refund unmatched excess. Best five of seven using displayed standard rank table wins showdown; ties split. Eight hands or bankruptcy ends.
More chips after eight hands wins; fewer loses; equal draws. Bankruptcy terminal loss/win. No real money.
